question: What paradox of removing reflective awareness and bearing all marks defines the deity?
premises: The deity removes the head of vimarśa
The deity is marked by all characteristics
inference: The deity transcends or cuts reflective limitation while encompassing all marks.
uncertainties: vimarśa may mean reflective awareness or doubt depending on context
plain_english: Obeisance to the remover of the head of reflective awareness; obeisance to the one marked by all marks.
